cards.front: What is the Levenshtein (edit) distance between two strings?
cards.back: The minimum number of single-character operations (insert, delete, substitute) needed to transform one string into the other.

cards.front: Which three operations are permitted when computing Levenshtein distance?
State the recurrence for dp[i][j] in edit distance (1-based).
What are the base cases for the edit-distance DP table?
cards.back: dp[i][0] = i (delete all), dp[0][j] = j (insert all) for i=0..m, j=0..n.

cards.front: What are the time and space complexities of the classic 2-D DP for edit distance?
cards.back: O(mn) time and O(mn) space, where m = |s|, n = |t|.

cards.front: How can edit distance be computed in O(n) space?
cards.back: Keep only the previous row (or two 1-D arrays). Update a single array of size n+1 from left to right, storing only the value above before overwriting.
